verdicts.reason: A shrinks the square's centre stack into the middle of the banner. The logo, can label, chips, CTA and legal text are all illegibly tiny, the five botanical chips are scattered in a ragged zigzag across the full width, and the sides are left as dead space. B does use the banner shape, with the can on the left and a large headline, but the hierarchy is broken. The legal line has been promoted to subhead size directly under the headline. The 'Build Your Mix' CTA has shrunk to chip size and been merged into the chip row, where its text is unreadable. The chip labels are microscopic and reordered, and the can is jammed against the left edge.
